page_title: CAG 0-2 UDI | Cagliari v Udinese 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Federico Dionisi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' A corner kick by Cagliari is thwarted by the well prepared Maduka Okoye (Udinese).

90+8' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+8' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+6' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Keinan Davis laid the ball off to Idrissa Gueye (Udinese), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+5' Keinan Davis (Udinese) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Elia Caprile.

90+1' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Maduka Okoye made a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Arthur Atta (Udinese) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
88' Here is a change. Michel Adopo is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Belotti (Cagliari).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yael Trepy (Cagliari) will replace Adam Obert.
86' Lennon Miller (Udinese) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

85' Keinan Davis (Udinese) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Elia Caprile. Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
82' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
80' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
80' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
78' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Arizala (Udinese) replacing Kingsley Ehizibue.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolo Zaniolo as he is replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
76' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
76' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Cagliari.
76' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
73' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Agustin Albarracin (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Michael Folorunsho can be given a rest.
71' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) makes a slide tackle, but referee Federico Dionisi blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Cagliari.
67' Lennon Miller (Udinese) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
67' Lennon Miller (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. Udinese have a corner.
65' Adam Buksa goes off the pitch and Keinan Davis (Udinese) comes on.
64' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
63' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
62' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Marco Palestra is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
62' Here comes a substitution. Jose Pedro is given a rest as he is replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).
56' 0 - 1 Goal! Hassane Kamara passes the ball to the feet of Adam Buksa (Udinese), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
56' Arthur Atta (Udinese) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' Arthur Atta (Udinese) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
55' The resulting set piece from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is successfully intercepted by the defender.
55' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Lennon Miller (Udinese) replaces Jakub Piotrowski.
55' A substitution has been made. Branimir Mlacic goes off and Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) comes on.
53' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Federico Dionisi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
52' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

52' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile punched it onto the post. Now Udinese have a corner.
49' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
45+1' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
44' The foul by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico Dionisi.
43' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle as Adam Buksa (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
39' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
38' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Elia Caprile and he's equal to it.
36' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
35' The Cagliari players are stunned as referee Federico Dionisi changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
34' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Cagliari as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
34' Handball! A player from Udinese handled the ball.
32' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adam Obert (Cagliari) is cleared to safety by the defence.

32' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
30' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
29' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
27' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!

24' What a great effort! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
23' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
22' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Federico Dionisi blows for a foul.
22' A pass by Paul Mendy (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

18' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
18' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
17' Arthur Atta (Udinese) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
15' The linesman signals that Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
12' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
11' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball has crossed the sideline. Udinese are taking a throw-in.
9' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
8' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
7' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
3' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick the game off.
